description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named ClientController that manages CRUD operations and view routing for Client entities within a CRM web application.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Controller handling client-related web requests such as adding, editing, viewing details, and adding similar clients.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Prepares the form for adding a new client by initializing a Client object and retrieving status list.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new client, validating input and delegating to service layer.

methods.name: editClient
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing an existing client identified by ID.

methods.name: seveClient
methods.description: Handles POST request to save edited client data, including validation and user association.

methods.name: clientDetails
methods.description: Displays detailed information of a client, including contracts and events.

methods.name: addSimilarClient
methods.description: Prepares form for adding a client similar to an existing one.
